title: Buyer beware on tray quantity
text:
Buyer beware on tray quantity. Well, my feelings on this are mixed, but not because of the tray itself.
The tray seems to be a nice quality. I bought them to make fat bombs for Paleo. I think they will be perfect for that use.

What ticks me off was how deceptive this listing was. It has since been changed, but the photo clearly shows TWO trays, and when I bought it, gave the drop-down choice of mixed colors or all green or all blue. I chose mixed. But when I received the order, I only got ONE tray!! Very irritating, since I could have purchased just one tray for $2.00 less from a different seller.

So, nice tray that will be useful for coconut oil recipes, but was a very deceptive listing. (Again, this has since changed to say one tray, but too late for me.)
